Existing candidate's trigger (second instance) has now FIRED — control-byte gate-check candidate already in the Director queue gains this as live evidence.
  2. Heartbeat-loop clock-skew: two $(date) calls for --now/--created-at raced a second boundary; CLI rejected "created_at must not be in the future". Cure: compute ONE timestamp per tick. Candidate clause for the liveness-heartbeat-cron rule's invocation example (rides alongside Pier's relabel + Scorched's stderr-capture candidates).
  3. comms reply --to-event-id requires the FULL event UUID (8-char prefix exits 2, loud); prefix-resolution affordance candidate for the CLI (second instance trigger).
  4. claims close from a worktree cwd with relative paths crashes (Scorched's class, SECOND instance at my hand) — absolute paths to the coordination home are the only safe shape; candidate: CLI could resolve --active/--closed relative to repo root of the COORDINATION home never cwd, or refuse relative paths outright.
  5. vocab-gen in a worktree needs apps/oak-search-cli/bulk-downloads (gitignored, machine-local): symlinking the primary checkout's data files into the worktree skeleton dir works and stays invisible to git; worth a line in the worktree-setup section of the team opener if more corpus cycles route to worktree seats.
  6. eef identity row: Prismatic Shimmering Planet / claude / fable-5 / 65394e / pr176-shepherd-then-keyword-stories-then-2b-dedup / 2026-06-11.
